label: Format (contextual tab)
purpose: contextual ribbon tab of the 'SmartArt Tools' family; exists only while: a SmartArt graphic is selected. Groups: Shapes, Shape Styles, WordArt Styles, Accessibility, Arrange, Size. Appeared on the 'smartart' probe.

children.label: Edit in 2-D
children.tooltip:
Change to 2-D view to resize and drag shapes in the SmartArt graphic.

This option is available only if you have applied a 3-D style to the SmartArt graphic.
children.state_notes: group 'Shapes'; keytip Alt, J O, E; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Change Shape
children.tooltip: Change the shape of the drawing, preserving all the formatting.
children.state_notes: group 'Shapes'; keytip Alt, J O, I; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Larger
children.tooltip: Increase the size of the selected shape.
children.state_notes: group 'Shapes'; keytip Alt, J O, N; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Smaller
children.tooltip: Decrease the size of the selected shape.
children.state_notes: group 'Shapes'; keytip Alt, J O, D; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: ShapeStylesGallery
children.tooltip:
Quickly add a visual style to the selected shape or line.

Each style uses a unique combination of colors, lines, and other effects to change the shape's appearance. Hover over a Quick Style in the gallery to preview your new look.
children.state_notes: group 'Shape Styles'; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Shape Fill

children.state_notes: group 'Shape Styles'; keytip Alt, J O, S F; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.tooltip: Pick the color, width, and line style for the outline of your shape.
children.state_notes: group 'Shape Styles'; keytip Alt, J O, S O; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Shape Effects
children.tooltip: Apply a visual effect to the selected shape, such as shadow, glow, reflection, or 3-D rotation.
children.state_notes: group 'Shape Styles'; keytip Alt, J O, S E; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Position
children.tooltip:
Choose where the selected object will appear on the page.

Text will automatically wrap around the object so that it's still easy to read.
children.state_notes: group 'Arrange'; keytip Alt, J O, P O; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Wrap Text
children.tooltip:
Choose how your text wraps around the selected object.

For example, you can choose to have the text continue around the object or cross right over it.
children.state_notes: group 'Arrange'; keytip Alt, J O, T W; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Bring Forward
children.tooltip: Bring the selected object forward one level, or bring it in front of all the other objects.
children.state_notes: group 'Arrange'; keytip Alt, J O, A F; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Send Backward

children.label: Selection Pane...
children.tooltip:
See a list of all your objects.

This makes it easier to select objects, change their order, or change their visibility.
children.state_notes: group 'Arrange'; keytip Alt, J O, A P; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Align
children.tooltip:
Change the placement of your selected objects on the page.

This is great for aligning objects to the margins or the edge of the page. You can also align them relative to one another.
children.state_notes: group 'Arrange'; keytip Alt, J O, A A; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)
